meta.title: Z.ai Web Tools (MCP)
meta.description: Powers the built-in web_search and web_fetch tools through the Z.ai web_search_prime and web_reader MCP servers, exposes mcp__zai__web_search_prime, mcp__zai-reader__webReader and the mcp__zai-vision__* image/video tools, and shows the live GLM Coding Plan quota chip near the composer's usage indicators. All surfaces use the stored ZAI_API_KEY credential.
